name: NumeralStepsList
job: Explain a process as large outlined numerals that fill solid and bring their step text forward one at a time as the visitor reads down
visitor_action: scroll through it; click a numeral to jump to that step
mobile: numerals shrink beside the text (same two-column sequence), thread runs straight down the left
art_direction: Wet ink on stone: oversized Bodoni Moda numerals (~42% of the frame width each) zigzag down the stage as matte aubergine ink vessels, each hosting its text beside it; a liquid thread swings from numeral to numeral. The ink rises with a meniscus and sloshing surface, cures flat, then extrudes toward the reader with 3D tilt and one restrained glint band. Soft stone stage, quiet Hanken Grotesk.
motion: Thread draws from one numeral across the frame to the next with a droplet on its head and splashes into it; the numeral fills with spring-driven wet ink (meniscus, scroll-inertia slosh, ripple); on full it cures matte and thuds out in 3D (10-slice extrusion, overshoot, tilt, glint sweep) while its text rises in beside it. Reduced-motion: all cured, slightly extruded, thread drawn, text shown.
